title: Character Turnaround — the knight from all sides, seeds kept
objective: Measure whether the character-turnaround craftbook produces front, side, back, and three-quarter views of one consistent figure and records every view in the manifest with the seed and prompt that made it — paths real, ids unique.
prompt: can you do a full turnaround for the knight charcter? we'll need it for the sprite work later

setup.about: Asset foundry project. The library's records live at workspace/assets/manifest.json (a JSON array, one record per asset) and the style anchor at workspace/assets/style.md. The knight's turnaround lands in workspace/assets/characters/knight; the summary goes to workspace/report.md.
setup.missionObjectives: One figure, four angles, reproducible later: every view generated against the style anchor and recorded with its seed and prompt, and no manifest record pointing at a file that is not there. No live services, no real credentials.

files.content:
# Asset library style anchor

- Character art: 96x128 pixel figures, heroic proportion (5 heads tall).
- Palette: iron gray #6e7681, brass trim #b08d3f, cloak red #7a2e2e,
  highlight cream #e8dcb8, outline near-black #22201c.
- Look: chunky 2px outlines, flat interior shading, one highlight edge
  top-left. No gradients, no anti-aliased edges.
- Turnarounds: assets/characters/<name>/<angle>.png — front, side, back,
  three-quarter — same figure, same scale, same palette in every view.
- Every shipped asset gets a manifest record: id, file, size, tags,
  seed, prompt — the seed and prompt are how the next sprite stays in style.

success.summary: assets/characters/knight holds the four turnaround views; the manifest records each with seed and prompt; tasks/eval/report.md hands the set to the sprite work.

checks.label: every recorded file exists on disk

axes.name: angle coverage
axes.description: Front, side, back, and three-quarter are all present at the convention names — a usable model sheet, not a portrait set.

axes.name: consistency
axes.description: The views read as one figure — same silhouette, proportions, palette, and scale in every view.

axes.name: silhouette readability
axes.description: The knight reads clearly at sprite distance; the shape survives shrinking.

axes.name: manifest quality
axes.description: Every view's record carries id, file, seed, and prompt; existing records untouched, ids unique, paths real.
